messages.subject: [Rpy] Conversion from R objects to numpy object fails
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] Conversion from R objects to numpy object fails
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have some python code using R functions with the help of the rpy2. I successfully can convert numpy objects to R objects with using robjects.conversion.py2ri, but now I would need to convert some R object to numpy ones and any solutions I could find on the net were failed. I have got a simple 2 dimension array and need to get a numpy array.

Could anyone help in this, please?

Thanks,
Gabi
